description: A background worker service ('job-worker') in the Docker Compose project at '/home/ga/zombie-debug/' is leaking zombie processes. The application generates subprocesses that become <defunct> because the container lacks a proper init process to reap them. Diagnose the issue using process tools (top/ps), then modify 'docker-compose.yml' to enable the built-in Docker init process (Tini) for the service. Do NOT modify the application code (worker.py). The goal is to stop zombies from accumulating while keeping the service running.
